description: This source file defines a utility class `Platform` that provides methods to identify the current operating system platform (Linux, Mac OS X, Windows) based on system properties.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: A utility class with constants for OS names and a method to check the current platform based on system properties.

methods.name: isPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the current system's OS name contains the specified platform string, case-insensitive.
